item.title: Diddy, Luigi Mangione, and My Stint in the Alexander Brothers Jury Pool
item.description: The high-flying real estate brokers, and their brother working in private security, are standing trial this week on sex trafficking charges. Before I was called for jury duty, I knew the defense team best as subjects.

item.title: All of Lady Gaga’s Grammys Looks Through the Years
item.description: The musician attended her first Grammy Awards in 2010 and typically dons about three different outfits throughout the night. One thing Grammys viewers can expect from Gaga? The unexpected.

item.title: Princess Ingrid Alexandra of Norway Pays Tribute to Her Grandparents With First Solo Royal Trip
item.description: The 22-year-old is currently visiting Finnmark, the same country in northern Norway that her grandparents made after their wedding in 1969.

item.title: Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie Keep Their Flame Burning for the 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: The Heated Rivalry stars walked the Olympic torch through Veneto on Sunday.

item.title: How Stylist James Yardley Fashioned Heated Rivalry’s Connor Storrie Into a Next Generation Leading Man
item.description: Connor Storrie found overnight fame with Heated Rivalry. His stylist James Yardley tells Vanity Fair about dressing the actor for superstardom.

item.title: Where Will Prince George Attend Secondary School?
item.description: While Prince William and Prince Harry both attended Eton College, a source tells VF that the Prince and Princess of Wales are “leaning towards other schools” for the future king’s secondary education.

item.title: Michael J. Fox and Harrison Ford on Shrinking, Parkinson’s, and Donald Trump
item.description: Following his first TV role in five years, Fox hopes to meet with Robert F. Kennedy Jr. about funding research for the incurable brain disease. But as he exclusively tells VF, the current administration “seems that they’re involved in other things that have less impact on peoples’ lives.”

item.title: David’s Quest to Become the Ultimate Status Protein Bar
item.description: Peter Rahal, who founded David in September 2024, calls the bars a new frontier of health, sold as a lifestyle. It’s not without controversy—or lawsuits.

item.title: What Do Cruz and Romeo Beckham Think of Their Family Feud
item.description: The two younger Beckham boys subtly signal their own views on David and Victoria's rift with Brooklyn and Nicola Peltz Beckham.

item.title: Lauren Sánchez Bezos Loves Suits, Be They Crimson, Fur-Collared, or Fringed
item.description: Front row in Paris for couture week, Jeff Bezos’s wife made inroads with designers and focused on a wardrobe classic.
